title: A donor with too little cloth
literal_meaning: A generous donor—and the cloth end does not reach the head.
meaning_odia: ଦାନୀ ବୋଲି ପରିଚୟ, ଅଥଚ ମୁଣ୍ଡ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ କାନି ପହଞ୍ଚୁନାହିଁ—ଏହି ଅମେଳକୁ ଆମେ ଏଠାରେ ପଢ଼ୁଛୁ। ନିଜ ସମ୍ବଳର ଅଭାବ ସାଙ୍ଗରେ ଉଦାରତାର ବଡ଼ ପରିଚୟ ରଖିଲେ ଯେଉଁ ବିରୋଧ ଦିଶେ, ତାହା ଏହାର ବ୍ୟଙ୍ଗ ହୋଇପାରେ। ଦାନ କରି କରି ଅଭାବ ହୋଇଛି ବୋଲି ମୂଳରେ କୁହାଯାଇନାହିଁ।
explanation: The label “generous donor” stands beside a cloth end too short to reach the head. Our editorial reading hears irony in a claim of generosity set against inadequate means. The line does not say that anything has actually been donated or that giving caused the shortage. The conversational ନା is rendered broadly through the turn marked by the English dash.
usage_example: Original imagined example: Someone advertises themselves as a major benefactor while having no supplies available for their own proposed work. A listener recalls the donor whose cloth does not reach the head.
cultural_context: The cloth end makes insufficiency visible in a small physical detail. Its short reach is set against the largeness of the donor label; no particular dress rule or ceremony is specified.

witnesses.note: Rendered upload inspected17November2026; exact wording, separate ନା and source punctuation retained. English handles ନା contextually as a conversational turn; its precise pragmatic force remains unconfirmed. Interpretation concerns the title/means contrast, not a documented donation.
